title: Repo hygiene audit + check script/CI job; README and docs/ rewritten for outside readers
notes: Audit of the tracked tree (1,836 files, 45 MB; experiments 26 MB): no caches, build output, data/model files, secrets, private e-mails, third-party PDFs/code or per-trial typed text. Nothing removed (no clear junk outside experiments/, which was not touched). New tools/hygiene/check.js + links.js, CI job 'hygiene', .gitignore rules (caches, node_modules, Rust target, model formats, experiments/**/DONE). 9 judgement calls H-1..H-9 for the user in wiki/questions/repo-hygiene.md. README.md rewritten (NTS in two sentences, OpenTelemetry analogy table, status, architecture, quickstarts, docs, related projects LSL/BCI2000/BIDS, layout, FEP contributing, licence/data). New docs/README.md index + getting-started, concepts, sdks, collector, conformance pages. SDK READMEs: status note + current vector counts. Agent stats: filled by the orchestrator.
